route_plan.query: For a mixed plastic feedstock of 8000 tonnes/year composed of 60% PE and 40% EVOH: first have the separation engineer propose operating parameters — the top 3 solvent candidates per polymer with recommended dissolution temperatures below 140 C. Then pass exactly those shortlisted candidates to the optimization engineer to run the cost-versus-emissions Pareto analysis with at least 1 STRAP wash step. Finally identify the Pareto-dominant knee point and report its selected solvents, total cost, and emissions, alongside the cheapest point for comparison.

steps.objective: Identify the top 3 solvent candidates for PE and EVOH with dissolution temperatures below 140 C.
Perform a cost-versus-emissions Pareto analysis for the 8000 tpy PE/EVOH feedstock using the shortlisted solvents and at least one STRAP wash step, identifying the knee point and cheapest point.

route_plan.rationale: The request follows a specific sequential workflow: solvent shortlisting by the separation engineer followed by multi-objective optimization.
